revenueSystem.primaryObjective: Create a measurable path from qualified attention to collected revenue and continued customer value.

managementControls.privacyBoundary: No customer identities, assessments, credentials, payment details, or private pricing belong in the public repository.
managementControls.commandCenterIntegrationStatus: operating architecture added; live source connections pending
financialRecordHierarchy: Podia records the customer order, product or enrollment.
Stripe records payment authorization, processing, fees, refunds and payout status.
The business bank account confirms settlement of funds.
The accounting system classifies transactions and serves as the formal reconciled financial record.
The PurposeSphere Command Center displays sanitized, verified summaries for monitoring, variance review and management confirmation.
managementControls.commandCenterRole: Management confirmation and check-and-balance layer only; not the legal ledger, payment processor, bank record or accounting system of record.
managementControls.reconciliationRule: Command Center totals must be traceable to and periodically reconciled against Podia, Stripe, bank and accounting records. Differences are flagged until resolved.
managementControls.categoryPostingRule: Assign each transaction to exactly one standardized revenue category. Do not create alternate labels or new categories without documented approval. Track products and offers separately from the accounting category.
managementControls.manualInterimProcedure: Until Podia, Stripe, bank and accounting feeds are securely connected, perform the unmatched-transaction check during the Friday financial close and notify Dr. G of every exception.

standardRevenueCategories.postingRule: Downloadable kits, templates, workbooks and other stand-alone digital purchases.
Self-paced or instructor-led educational programs sold as courses.
Open-enrollment workshops, seminars, webinars and paid public training.
Services delivered to one contracting organization, including Purpose-Centered AI Alignment Workshop™.
Strategy, implementation guidance, retainers, Fiverr consulting and multi-session advisory engagements.
Purposeologist™ certification, credentialing, practicum and approved renewal fees.
Recurring membership, community or subscription revenue.
Paid assessments, organizational evaluations and related interpretation services.
Keynotes, panels, guest teaching, speaking engagements and appearance fees.
Printed books, ebooks, audiobooks, workbooks and publishing-related sales.
Authorized licensing of curricula, media, characters, methods, content or other intellectual property.
Sponsorship payments and paid partnership arrangements not earned through another service category.
Private Purposeology® experiences and other bespoke premium engagements.
Branded merchandise, physical products and heirloom products such as The Book of Purpose.
Grant awards and contributions legally received by an eligible entity; not customer sales.
Rare operating income that cannot reasonably be classified elsewhere; requires Centurion review before use.

revenueSystem.financialClassificationPrinciple: Every record must have exactly one standardized revenue category (R01–R16) and exactly one current financial-status classification (F01–F04). Revenue categories and financial statuses are separate dimensions and must never be blended.

standardFinancialStatuses.definition: A planning target or forecast not tied to an active customer commitment.
standardFinancialStatuses.evidenceRequired: Approved budget, forecast or planning assumption.

standardFinancialStatuses.definition: A specific active sales opportunity without a fully executed customer agreement.
standardFinancialStatuses.evidenceRequired: Identified prospect, offer, estimated value, stage, probability, next action and due date.

standardFinancialStatuses.definition: An amount supported by a signed agreement, confirmed order or enforceable invoice that has not yet been received.
standardFinancialStatuses.evidenceRequired: Executed agreement, confirmed order or valid invoice plus payment due date.

standardFinancialStatuses.definition: Funds actually received and confirmed through the approved payment processor or bank.
standardFinancialStatuses.evidenceRequired: Processor transaction and/or bank settlement record.

nonBlendingRules: Do not report projected revenue as pipeline, booked revenue or collected cash.
Do not report pipeline value as booked revenue or collected cash.
Do not report a verbal commitment as booked revenue.
Do not report an invoice as collected until payment is confirmed.
When part of a signed contract is paid, classify the paid portion as F04 Collected and the remaining enforceable balance as F03 Booked but Uncollected.
Do not add F01, F02, F03 and F04 together to state total revenue.
Report each amount by standardized category and financial status, with source evidence and last verification date.
Any record missing a category, status or required evidence is Unclassified and excluded from official totals until corrected.

salesRecordControl.principle: No transaction may be treated as official revenue, receivable, refund or customer credit without a matching sales record.
salesRecordControl.reportingRule: Any financial transaction or expected payment without a matching sales record is excluded from official totals and immediately placed on the Unmatched Transaction Exception Report until resolved.

requiredFields: what is supposed to be paid or refunded
unmatchedTransactionExceptionReport.notificationThreshold: Every unmatched transaction or expected payment, regardless of amount.
unmatchedTransactionExceptionReport.resolutionRule: Create or correct the supporting sales record, match the transaction to evidence, verify category and financial status, and document who resolved it and when. Never manufacture a sales record solely to force a match.

primaryFinancialControlIssues: Revenue Category and Financial Status Classification

invoiceAndDepositControl.principle: Every transaction must have a documented invoice or approved checkout receipt and an explicit deposit status. Blank invoice or deposit fields are prohibited.

applicability.transactionType: Organizational, custom, speaking, advisory and contracted services
applicability.invoiceRule: Written agreement and formal invoice required before delivery.
applicability.depositRule: Deposit required to reserve capacity unless a written exception is approved in Special Agreements.

applicability.transactionType: Low-cost digital products, public workshop registrations and other pay-in-full checkout sales
applicability.invoiceRule: Podia order plus Stripe receipt may serve as the invoice/receipt record.
applicability.depositRule: Mark Not Applicable — Paid in Full; do not leave blank.

applicability.invoiceRule: Order, total obligation and installment schedule required.
applicability.depositRule: Record first installment as deposit only when the agreement expressly defines it as a deposit; otherwise classify it as an installment.

applicability.invoiceRule: No invoice required, but an approved zero-dollar sales/service record is required.
applicability.depositRule: Mark Not Applicable — Complimentary; do not leave blank.

invoiceAndDepositControl.standardServiceDepositRule: Unless changed by a written, approved concession, contracted services require a 50% nonrefundable deposit at signing to reserve the date, with the remaining balance due five business days before delivery. Counsel and the Provider’s accountant must review this rule before contractual use.
requiredFields: invoice number or checkout receipt ID
exception approval and reason if applicable
prohibitedConditions: delivery marked ready when a required deposit is missing
collected amount reported without receipt or processor evidence

invoiceDepositExceptionAlert.trigger: Any missing, incomplete, overdue, inconsistent or unverified invoice or deposit entry.
invoiceDepositExceptionAlert.actionRule: Notify Dr. G when the issue becomes known; flag the record until corrected; do not mark the service ready for delivery when a required agreement, invoice or deposit is missing.
resolutionEvidence: verified deposit or approved written exception

preEngagementBudgetControl.principle: Centurion prepares a short engagement budget for Dr. G’s written approval before travel is booked, external costs are committed or engagement delivery begins.
appliesTo: any engagement with travel, contractors, production or reimbursable costs
revenueInputs: approved reimbursable expenses billed to client
sponsorship or partner contribution tied to engagement
costInputs: airfare, rail or other intercity transportation
local transportation, rental vehicle, fuel, mileage, tolls and parking
lodging, occupancy taxes, resort/destination fees and internet
meals, per diem and approved hospitality
venue rental, room setup, security and permits
audio/visual, internet, streaming, recording and technical support
printing, workbooks, participant materials, supplies and shipping
contractors, facilitators, assistants, photographers, videographers and editors
accessibility services such as captioning or interpretation
insurance, licensing or required event fees
marketing or audience-acquisition costs directly attributable to the engagement
preparation labor, travel time, delivery time and follow-up time for internal profitability analysis
tax reserve shown separately from direct delivery cost
requiredCalculations: internal labor hours and assigned internal value
gross cash profit = contracted revenue minus direct cash costs
economic contribution = contracted revenue minus direct cash costs minus internal labor value
cash required before reimbursement or final payment
approvalFields: Dr. G decision: Approved / Approved with Conditions / Revise / Declined
prohibitedActions: incurring unbudgeted material expenses without approval
delivering when required deposit or budget approval is missing
preEngagementBudgetControl.varianceRule: Reapproval is required when total expected cost increases by more than 10%, any unbudgeted single cost exceeds $250, expected revenue decreases, expected margin materially declines, or travel/scope changes.
preEngagementBudgetControl.closeoutRule: Within five business days after delivery, Centurion compares budget to actual revenue and costs, explains variances, calculates final profitability and records lessons for future pricing.
